text:
maria: Incoming pen-test report from BlackWave. Filing preliminary triage here.

sam: Thanks. What's the scope? staging only or includes dedicated clusters?

maria: Staging only for now. They flagged an auth bypass on the tokenization endpoint and missing audit log fragments around key unwrap events. Report ID: BW-2026-88.

josh: I'll own triage for the tokenization exploit. Need a reproducible payload and the staging snapshot. Can we preserve 48h of full auth traces and the proxy logs? Also need the sample tokenized payloads.

leah: I'll handle evidence gating and chain-of-custody. We should create a fresh evidence prefix and compute sha256 of each upload. Prefer presigned URLs for assessor pulls, per policy.

audit_bot: audit-bot: Evidence bucket folder created: s3://pt-evidence/BW-2026-88/ ; manifest file pending. Please attach hashes when uploading.

sam: KMS question: assessor needs to verify wrap/unwrap behavior. We must not grant Decrypt for production/customer keys. Proposal: create a staging-only KMS key alias and a proxy role that allows kms:Encrypt and kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext but denies kms:Decrypt for any key with tag environment:prod.

josh: Proxy role sounds good. Can we use an assume-role session that only allows calls from the assessor IP range and has a max session of 2 hours?

sam: Yes. Sketch:

```
# Assume role condition
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Action":"sts:AssumeRole",
    "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::ASSESSOR:role/assessor"},
    "Condition":{"IpAddress":{"aws:SourceIp":"203.0.113.0/24"}}
  }]
}

# KMS inline policy (high level)
"Action":["kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext","kms:Encrypt","kms:ReEncrypt*"],
"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*",
"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:ViaService":"kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"}}
```

leah: Important: we must record the IAM role creation event in the audit logs and snapshot the CloudTrail for the window. Also add a rollback runbook in case the assessor triggers unexpected requests.

maria: Legal signed safe-ops. They allow controlled exploit replays in staging within a limited window. Ops: please coordinate rate-limit lifts and quota increases for that window.

infra: Opening infra ticket INFRA-4217 to temporarily bump log retention and create a staging key alias. ETA: 30h. Ticket: https://go/redwood/INFRA-4217

josh: For telemetry snapshots, we need these indices: proxy-access-*, auth-trace-*, tokenization-*; time window: t-24h to t+6h. We'll snapshot to evidence path and include checksums.

leah: I'll post the chain-of-custody checklist in the tracker and share presigned upload URLs once infra gives go.

sam: One more: deny list for the role to prevent Extract/Decrypt on any key with tag tenant:true. We'll bake that into the key policy.

maria: Action summary: 1) infra -> INFRA-4217 (create staging KMS alias, bump retention) 2) sam -> role + key policy + IP restriction 3) josh -> reproduce payloads & telemetry snapshot plan 4) leah -> evidence prefix + hashes + rollback runbook 5) audit_bot -> manifest and presigned URL support. Target test window: next Wed 09:00-11:00 PST with Thu fallback. 

leah: I'll schedule the ops bridge and put the checklist in the tracker. If we need to delay, update here quickly.

audit_bot: note: please tag uploads with metadata: report_id=BW-2026-88, uploader=<name>, sha256=<hash>. Automated verification will run on receipt.

maria: Thanks all. Post short updates only if blockers. :raised_hands:
